# Backend Neutrality Checklist: Supervised Autonomous Loop

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of
provider and coding-harness neutrality requirements
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) and [execution backend contract](../contracts/execution-backend.schema.json)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Boundary Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are agent identity, runtime, backend descriptor, connection, model descriptor, and optional provider session defined as separate concepts with stable identity rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003/FR-011; Data Model §Execution resources]
- [x] CHK002 Are Model API, Coding Harness, and Local Runtime backend families specified as distinct even though slice 001 implements only a fake backend? [Completeness, Constitution §IV; Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK003 Are Moonshift-owned request, event, result, error, usage, capability, tool, and checkpoint contracts defined without provider or framework types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027/FR-029; Plan §Data, Contracts, and Security Design]
- [x] CHK004 Are API-key, subscription, workspace/enterprise, and unauthenticated fixture connection modes required to remain separate rather than inferred from a vendor name? [Clarity, Constitution §IV/XV; Research §R-009]
- [x] CHK005 Does the scope explicitly distinguish a protocol/profile such as OpenRouter from a domain subtype and require arbitrary compatible endpoints to be probed? [Coverage, Architecture §Execution Backends; Gap]

## Capability and Conformance Quality

- [x] CHK006 Is each optional capability—including structured output, streaming, tools, cancellation, resume, artifacts, and usage—specified with supported/unsupported/unknown semantics and evidence? [Clarity, Data Model §CapabilityDescriptor]
- [x] CHK007 Are the fake backend's advertised capabilities, unsupported capabilities, deterministic inputs, and conformance evidence exhaustive enough to reject false support claims? [Completeness, Contract §Fake Backend]
- [x] CHK008 Are failure normalization, timeout, cancellation, budget, and retryability requirements expressed in Moonshift terms rather than provider-specific codes? [Consistency, Contract §Failure normalization]
- [x] CHK009 Are conformance failures required to remove a connection from routing eligibility rather than silently weaken task requirements? [Clarity, Contract §Conformance evidence]
- [x] CHK010 Can cross-instance resume be objectively assessed without requiring a provider session identifier or changing logical agent/task identity? [Measurability, Spec §FR-028/SC-005]

## Routing, Terms, and Future Compatibility

- [x] CHK011 Are backend route inputs and exclusions sufficiently specified to preserve capability, privacy, budget, health, capacity, and independent-review constraints? [Coverage, Plan §Execution and runner path; Architecture §Routing and Checkpoints]
- [x] CHK012 Are subscription quota/lease requirements separated from monetary API usage so the system cannot invent per-task subscription cost? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities; Data Model §Budget and UsageRecord]
- [x] CHK013 Are current automation and terms facts explicitly dated and treated as renewable evidence rather than permanent product claims? [Clarity, Research §Backend Compatibility; Constitution §XV]
- [x] CHK014 Are OpenRouter, generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, and Gemini CLI represented in roadmap/research with appropriately different support and policy status? [Coverage, Docs §Backend Compatibility; Feature Map §002–004]
- [x] CHK015 Are future adapter and language replacements possible without changing Project, Task, identity, memory, evidence, or checkpoint contracts? [Consistency, Constitution §II/VI; ADR 0003]

## Notes

- Independent requirements review accepted all 15/15 items on 2026-08-31.
- Findings belong beside the item or in the analysis/remediation record; checking an item does not
  claim backend implementation or legal support.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
